info.title: Gruvi Content Distribution API
info.description: Upload finished media, publish or schedule posts, prepare carousels, schedule batches and read connected-account analytics. HTTPS JSON API with bearer agent keys. Preparation is available before subscribing; publishing requires an active plan, trial or complimentary access. OpenAPI 3.1 describes the deployed contract, not an unauthenticated API.

get.description: Beta engagement summary for the most recent posts, cached for five minutes. Requires an exact connected accountId and platform read permissions. Missing metrics are null, not zero. X uses the platform identifier twitter.

Read one bounded page of posts and their lifetime engagement. Default 10 posts; minimum 5, maximum 25. For the next page, pass paging.nextCursor unchanged with the same accountId and limit. Stop when paging.hasMore is false. Cursors expire after one hour and are tied to the authenticated owner, connection credentials and page size. On ANALYTICS_CURSOR_INVALID, restart without a cursor. Pages are cached for up to five minutes. No automatic full-history fetch. Platform visibility and API access can limit history. Missing counts are null, never zero. Page totals are separate from account-insights date ranges. Analytics does not require a publishing subscription.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the latest posts.

200.description: One post page, with page-only lifetime totals and continuation metadata.

thumbnailUrl.description: HTTPS image cover from the platform when available. May expire. Missing artwork is null; video file URLs are never used as image covers.

caption.description: Post caption or text, capped at 2000 characters. title retains the short 200-character preview.

totals.description: Sums of the known lifetime counts on this page only. Unknown totals remain null.

400.description: Invalid input or ANALYTICS_CURSOR_INVALID. Restart from the first page if the cursor expired or the connection changed.

403.description: Reconnect the account or check provider read permissions.

404.description: Connected account not found for this owner and platform.
